source: NVDA Alpaca SIP 15m regular split; official Alpaca calendar; 41A/41B SMA
availability: bar close plus 20 minutes, simulated, not verified historical receipt
alignment: strict SMA20 > SMA40 bullish, < bearish, equality defers transition
restart: confirmed return to the immediately preceding alignment in a continuous binary sequence; overlapping pairs allowed; every restart is also a change
continuity: all scheduled source intervals and adjacent official sessions required; gaps reset regime and ATR
firstVisit: regime origin confirmed, at least one full candle strictly on regime side of SMA, then first touch; consecutive touches form one episode
subsequentVisit: another full separation followed by another touch in same regime
leftCensoring: initial alignment and alignment after any gap cannot yield a true first visit
rejection: 41A geometric interaction known at event candle close
entry: first scheduled candle opening strictly after event assumed availability
horizonBoundary: 15m and 1h within same official session; daily across consecutive official sessions
atr: 14 prior/current complete true ranges in same continuous frame, split adjusted SIP
favorable: terminal signed close minus entry > 0.5 ATR
adverse: terminal signed close minus entry < -0.5 ATR
barrierAmbiguity: first favorable and adverse threshold touch in same bar
comparison: first versus later; bullish versus bearish; CHANGE versus RESTART; all nonvisit eligible bars in same SMA/regime/age-bin/local-slot, selected before outcomes
bootstrap: paired complete-session and complete-regime resampling, seed 4107, 1000 replicates
insufficientEvidence: fewer than 30 evaluable events or 30 independent sessions
studyPeriod: full verified SIP history and overlapping 2024-06-10 through 2026-10-23
